title: Show filter above navigation
prompt:
In lib/screens/songs/songs_list_screen.dart, locate this exact code in _showFilterOptions:

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      builder: (context) => StatefulBuilder(

Replace it with:

    showModalBottomSheet<void>(
      context: context,
      useRootNavigator: true,
      builder: (context) => StatefulBuilder(

This places the existing scrollable filter sheet above the app's bottom navigation. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: rg -q -F '      useRootNavigator: true,' lib/screens/songs/songs_list_screen.dart && dart analyze lib/screens/songs/songs_list_screen.dart && flutter test test/screens/songs/songs_list_screen_test.dart
